function.name: LOAD_MPEG
function.param: 1 to activate the reproduction of video
1 to activate the reproduction of audio
function.abstract: It recovers of disk an archive of video

description.p: It opens a MPEG archive in disk, to reproduce it with later.

This function returns an entire number that identifies to the video, or -1 if the archive is not in MPEG format or happens another error. You can use the returned number to reproduce the music by the function .
The additional parameters allows to activate or deactivate the reproduction of video and audio, respectively. You can use it to reproduce a video where only one of both elements is interesting.
